Told @ABC that it is not entirely clear that the Straits are open, just as much as it isn't clear whether Trump's blockade ever was really implemented. 

But Tehran is demonstrating here through this move that it decides whether the Strait is open or closed. 

abcnews.com/video/132143652/

Told Pakistani TV's @Fahdhusain that while Pakistan has done a good job facilitating and mediating the talks thus far, if they reach a framework agreement, pressure from Israel to sabotage the talks for a final deal will become far more intense.

piped.video/watch?v=ZS3qBshr…

Two reliable sources in Iran tell me the Iranian delegation has been instructed to be ready to travel to Islamabad on very short notice. 

But one also points out that hard-line resistance against a deal with the US has become louder, presenting a major political challenge.

MUST READ article by international law expert @MsJamshidi assessing the legality of Iran's asserted control over the Straits, while also putting it in the context of the larger picture with the undisputable illegality of the war itself:

thenation.com/article/world/…

Finally got my hands on @Azodiac83's new book, "Iran and the Bomb"! 

Can't wait to read it - you should get your own copy here: 

amazon.com/Iran-Bomb-United-…

Iran appears to be using some of Trump's tactics against Trump. Such as making grandiose & vague statements declaring a major achievement, even though it isn't fully being implemented or agreed upon. Such as "the Straits are fully open" vs "Iran has agreed to end enrichment"...

Kallas starts her sentence with "Under international law..."

Yet, under the entire genocide in Gaza, Europe completely ignored international law. When the US attacked Venezuela, EU leaders explicitly stated that this was not the time to discuss international law. They repeated that when the US attacked Iran.

But now, Kallas returns to opening her sentence with "international law." 

International law is not an optional feature of international relations that you invoke only when it suits you.
